title: PDF files open in the wrong app
symptom: PDF files open in an unwanted program
user_description: Every PDF now opens in some strange program instead of the one I normally use. How do I put it back?

options.text: Rename all her PDF files to a different extension
options.why: Messy and breaks sharing. The problem is which program opens PDFs, not the files themselves.
Never the first step. It is a huge fix for a small setting.

options.text: Right-click a PDF, choose Open with, select the right app and tick Always use this app, or set it in Default apps
options.why: File types are linked to a default program in Windows. Changing that link once fixes every PDF.
May break other things that need that program. Changing the default is simpler and safer.

hints: What decides which program opens a particular type of file?
Where could you change that choice?
Is the file broken, or just the program it opens with?
real_world_tip: Walk her through it once and she can fix it herself next time, saving you a ticket.
